Description: A white trash habitual petty criminal, regularly caught in the act on Fuzz, a COPS-like program. Known for the catchphrases Y'all are brutalizing me and Let's have us a champagne jam!. Sketch also launched Maynard James Keenan's band Puscifer.
An eccentric billionaire computer genius who invented the delete key, loves vegan sweets and retarded goats.
A pretentious man clad in a long scarf, even in hot weather, and friend of Droopy. He shuns popular American culture and modern technology.
British television producer who discovers Ronnie Dobbs and tries to utilize him in a West End-like fashion.
A blue-haired comedian who serves as a parody of Carrot Top known for his use of nonsensical props
A dandy who makes occasional silent, walk-ons. First seen clad in Edwardian garb he makes his second appearance in a more Elizabethan style.
A twenty-something slacker. He wants to work at a local museum, though he has few qualifications. He never went by any name during the show.
An R&B duo from Scarsdale made up of Pootie T.  and Wolfgang Amadeus Thelonius Von Funkenmeister the XIX 3/4 . They are sponsored by The WPCBCN .
A hyperactive comedian whose humor is overblown.
A director known for his documentary Naked Ambition and Coupon: The Movie. Son of, among others, recently divorced newscast members.
